$comment: Corresponding-source copies: operator task 26 (PROGRESS.md) and npm run build:offline -- --sources <folder> (unresolved 211).
Read by scripts/release/fetch-sources.ps1 (Windows PowerShell 5.1), scripts/lib/offline-sources.mjs and tests/unit/release/. Guide: scripts/release/README.md.
sha256/md5 = official value (hashSource says where it comes from). null = no official value: fetch-sources.ps1 records the SHA-256 (RECORD); pin it here afterwards.
site = the versions this list belongs to. When the site ships another Pyodide, OpenCV wheel or Pagefind, npm test fails until this list is updated.

groups.title: FFmpeg 4.4.1 (LGPL-2.1-or-later) statically linked into the OpenCV wheel
groups.titleKo: OpenCV 휠 안의 FFmpeg 4.4.1(GNU LGPL 2.1 이상)
groups.why: LGPL-2.1 section 6: whoever receives cv2.so must be able to get the source of FFmpeg (with any changes - there are none) and of the work that uses it, with the scripts that build them, so that they can change FFmpeg and relink cv2.so.
groups.whyKo: LGPL-2.1 6조: cv2.so를 받은 사람이 FFmpeg 소스(고친 곳 — 여기서는 없음)와 FFmpeg를 쓰는 저작물의 소스·빌드 방법을 받아, FFmpeg를 고쳐 cv2.so를 다시 연결할 수 있어야 해요.
groups.tools: Emscripten 5.0.3 and its ports zlib 1.3.1, libjpeg 9f and libpng 1.6.55 (distributed with the compiler - LGPL-2.1 section 6 does not require them), the Pyodide cross-build environment 314.0.6, and the CMake and Python build tools named in the recipes
groups.toolsKo: Emscripten 5.0.3과 그 포트 zlib 1.3.1·libjpeg 9f·libpng 1.6.55(컴파일러와 함께 나오는 것 — LGPL-2.1 6조가 요구하지 않음), Pyodide 교차 빌드 환경 314.0.6, 레시피에 적힌 CMake·파이썬 빌드 도구

groups.title: Search engine wasm with the GPL-3.0-only crate pagefind_microjson 0.1.4 (Pagefind 1.5.2)
groups.titleKo: 사이트 검색 엔진 wasm 안의 GPL-3.0 크레이트 pagefind_microjson 0.1.4(Pagefind 1.5.2)
groups.binary: pagefind/wasm.unknown.pagefind in the site folder (written by Pagefind 1.5.2 at build time)
groups.binaryKo: 사이트 폴더의 pagefind/wasm.unknown.pagefind(빌드 때 Pagefind 1.5.2가 씀)
groups.why: GPL-3.0 section 6: the Corresponding Source of the whole wasm - Pagefind v1.5.2 (pagefind_web and its build scripts) and every crates.io crate in pagefind_web/Cargo.lock (the set cargo vendor downloads: 12 compiled into the wasm, 9 used only while building it).
groups.whyKo: GPL-3.0 6조: wasm 전체의 대응 소스 — Pagefind v1.5.2(pagefind_web과 빌드 스크립트)와 pagefind_web/Cargo.lock에 적힌 crates.io 크레이트 전부(cargo vendor가 받는 범위: wasm에 든 12개, 만들 때만 쓰는 9개).
groups.tools: Rust nightly 1.97.0 (bf4fbfb7a 2026-04-11) with its standard library source (rust-src, rebuilt with -Z build-std - a system library of the compiler), wasm-pack with the wasm-bindgen 0.2.117 CLI, Node.js and gzip (pagefind_web/local_build.sh)
groups.toolsKo: Rust nightly 1.97.0(bf4fbfb7a 2026-04-11)과 그 표준 라이브러리 소스(rust-src — -Z build-std로 함께 빌드, 컴파일러의 시스템 라이브러리), wasm-pack·wasm-bindgen 0.2.117 CLI, Node.js·gzip(pagefind_web/local_build.sh)
